description: With just 55 days until Election Day, and 9 until early voting, South Dakota voters should be able to trust that the rules governing their elections are clear, consistent, and secure.Instead, we are watching the Trump Administration push new federal requirements for mail-in voting that could create confusion for voters and election officials just weeks before an election. title: South Dakotans Deserve Clear, Secure Elections
